svg.aria-label: Tanmay's World: an isometric 3D map where every chapter of Tanmay's journey is a building. India island: SKN Sinhgad, Apexon, The Socials Web, Lonavala Villas, Vatsalya GCL, Nurture+, BatchMates HQ, WeSchool, SIRP Library, AI Lab, Trophy Hall. A plane flies to the Germany island: Uni Bamberg, IS Management, Autohaus Sperber, Munich Job Fair, Berlin and Paris.

g.text: India → Germany → home. 18 places, one journey.
